intro: A causal language model predicts the token after each input position. Padding must not accidentally become a training target.
task: Shift a padded token batch into aligned inputs and targets, and mark the valid prediction positions.
requirements: tokens is an integer batch-by-time matrix with values 0..1000000 and time>=2. lengths is one integer valid-token count per row, in 2..time. padding_id is an integer 0..1000000.

Return {"inputs": tokens[:,:-1] with invalid positions replaced by padding_id, "targets": tokens[:,1:] with invalid positions replaced by padding_id, "mask": boolean matrix}. A position t is valid exactly when t<length-1. Values after each length are ignored.

Use finite real numeric values of magnitude at most 1e6, excluding boolean inputs. Each array axis has 1..64 entries and at most 65536 elements total unless a stricter bound is stated. Return NumPy arrays for array outputs, preserve caller inputs, and raise ValueError for invalid inputs.

examples.name: Unequal sequence lengths
examples.output:
{'inputs': [[2, 3, 0], [5, 0, 0]],
 'targets': [[3, 4, 0], [6, 0, 0]],
 'mask': [[True, True, False], [True, False, False]]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

examples.name: Full sequence
examples.output:
{'inputs': [[1, 2]], 'targets': [[2, 3]], 'mask': [[True, True]]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

examples.name: Minimum pair
examples.output:
{'inputs': [[7]], 'targets': [[8]], 'mask': [[True]]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

hints.title: Follow the data
hints.body: For a sequence of length L there are L-1 adjacent prediction pairs.

hints.title: Check the boundary
hints.body: Apply the same position mask to both sides of each pair.

explanation: Shifting creates supervised targets from an existing sequence without a separate label file. The model sees a prefix position and learns to predict its immediate successor.

Masking based on explicit lengths avoids confusing a padding identifier with a genuine token that happens to use the same value. This operation prepares labels; the model must separately enforce causal attention.
